statement_texts: SELECT basin.id, basin.name, basin.regulation_class, basin.outlet_fp_id, basin.huc8, basin.centroid, basin.bbox, basin.geometry_ref, basin.regulated_by, basin.susceptibility_gauge_id, basin.susceptibility_confidence_ceiling, basin.susceptibility_note FROM basin ORDER BY basin.id
SELECT source_product.id, source_product.source_id, source_product.label, source_product.variables, source_product.expected_cadence_seconds, source_product.grace_seconds FROM source_product

SELECT forecast_point.id, forecast_point.lid, forecast_point.name, forecast_point.station_id, forecast_point.basin_id, forecast_point.upstream_lids, forecast_point.downstream_lids, forecast_point.reach_id, forecast_point.datums, forecast_point.rfc, forecast_point.wfo, forecast_point.in_service, forecast_point.lon, forecast_point.lat FROM forecast_point WHERE forecast_point.lid IN (?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?)

SELECT station.id, station.agency, station.external_id, station.name, station.basin_id, station.lon, station.lat, station.vertical_datum, station.time_zone, station.tidal_class FROM station WHERE station.id IN (?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?)

SELECT threshold.id, threshold.fp_id, threshold.product_id, threshold.category, threshold.value, threshold.unit, threshold.basis, threshold.datum, threshold.source_kind, threshold.effective_from, threshold.retrieved_at, threshold.raw_artifact_id FROM threshold WHERE threshold.fp_id IN (?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?) AND threshold.effective_from <= ? ORDER BY threshold.fp_id, threshold.effective_from, threshold.id

SELECT anon_1.id, anon_1.product_id, anon_1.fp_id, anon_1.issued_at, anon_1.retrieved_at, anon_1.available_at, anon_1.issuer, anon_1.primary_variable, anon_1.unit, anon_1.stage_unit, anon_1.flow_unit, anon_1.datum, anon_1.raw_artifact_id, anon_1.supersedes_run_id FROM (SELECT forecast_run.id AS id, forecast_run.product_id AS product_id, forecast_run.fp_id AS fp_id, forecast_run.issued_at AS issued_at, forecast_run.retrieved_at AS retrieved_at, forecast_run.available_at AS available_at, forecast_run.issuer AS issuer, forecast_run.primary_variable AS primary_variable, forecast_run.unit AS unit, forecast_run.stage_unit AS stage_unit, forecast_run.flow_unit AS flow_unit, forecast_run.datum AS datum, forecast_run.raw_artifact_id AS raw_artifact_id, forecast_run.supersedes_run_id AS supersedes_run_id, row_number() OVER (PARTITION BY forecast_run.fp_id ORDER BY forecast_run.issued_at DESC, forecast_run.id DESC) AS rank FROM forecast_run WHERE forecast_run.fp_id IN (?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?) AND forecast_run.available_at <= ? AND forecast_run.product_id IN (?, ?, ?)) AS anon_1 WHERE anon_1.rank = ?

SELECT forecast_value.id, forecast_value.run_id, forecast_value.valid_time, forecast_value.stage, forecast_value.flow FROM forecast_value WHERE forecast_value.run_id IN (?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?) ORDER BY forecast_value.run_id, forecast_value.valid_time

AND observation.variable IN (?, ?) AND observation.available_at <= ? AND observation.valid_time >= ? AND observation.valid_time <= ?) AS anon_1 WHERE anon_1.rank = ?
